# Literature and scope assessment

## Claim being assessed

For $n\ge2$, $0<s<n$, $p,q>0$, and $A,B\in\mathbb R$, consider strictly positive continuous functions $u,v:\mathbb R^n\to(0,\infty)$, finite everywhere, satisfying pointwise
\[
u(x)=c\int_{\mathbb R^n}\frac{|y|^A v(y)^p}{|x-y|^{n-s}}\,dy,\qquad
v(x)=c\int_{\mathbb R^n}\frac{|y|^B u(y)^q}{|x-y|^{n-s}}\,dy
\]
for a fixed $c>0$. The proposed theorem excludes such solutions when
\[
\frac{n+A}{p+1}+\frac{n+B}{q+1}>n-s.
\]

The class is globally continuous and finite, but imposes no radiality, decay, boundedness, stability, or global integrability/finite-energy condition. This explicit class matters: origin finiteness forces $A,B>-s$, and positivity plus the equations forces $pq>1$.

## Historical conjecture and solution-class caveat

Caristi, D’Ambrosio, and Mitidieri, “Representation Formulae for Solutions to Some Classes of Higher Order Systems and Related Liouville Theorems,” *Milan Journal of Mathematics* 76 (2008), 27–67, [DOI: 10.1007/s00032-008-0090-3](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00032-008-0090-3), §5, introduce the unweighted HLS integral system and state its “HLS Conjecture”: for $N>\alpha>0$, $p,q>0$, if
\[
\frac1{p+1}+\frac1{q+1}>\frac{N-\alpha}{N},
\]
then the system has no nontrivial positive solutions. The conjecture sentence does not specify a function space or explicitly say whether the integral equations are required pointwise everywhere or only almost everywhere. Do not recast it as a theorem about all measurable a.e. solutions.

Their proved radial result is more precise: Theorem 5.1 assumes $N>\alpha\ge2$, $p,q>0$, and a nonnegative radial solution in $C^2(\mathbb R^N)\times C^2(\mathbb R^N)$; it concludes zero under the same hyperbola. Remark 5.3 identifies the radial case $0<\alpha<2$ as open at that time. The paper discusses PDE/integral representation formulas holding a.e. under suitable hypotheses, so a result for the direct pointwise integral system should not automatically be presented as a resolution of every associated PDE formulation.

There are singular a.e. counterexamples to an unrestricted measurable interpretation. In the scalar case $p=q$ with $p>n/(n-s)$, the power
\[
u(x)=C|x|^{-s/(p-1)}
\]

# Source provenance and verification boundaries

The proof mechanism comes from OpenAI, *The Subcritical Hénon–Lane–Emden Conjecture*, September 24, 2026, family 370 in the OpenAI Math repository.

Immutable revision accessed: fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb.

[Source manuscript directory](https://github.com/openai/math/tree/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/preprints/The-Subcritical-Henon-Lane-Emden-Conjecture-September-24-2026)

The upstream_source folder contains unmodified copies of the exact proof sections inspected, the manuscript README and author attribution, the associated Lean comparator, and the repository's Apache 2.0 license. Git blob hashes of the local source copies were recomputed and matched the connector's returned hashes:

- 02-preliminaries.tex: 4d0b73f7b963ab83b0de5e2d063b0669b40ba567
- 03-localization.tex: a1660194caa44b79d8df552b76478059843120a5
- 04-intervals.tex: 25e10d1a86a3b5ed3f9f77de3d54ad413c805adf
- 05-pressure.tex: d3deb4a82a9c3b45b3f2e4c0862ba88bb5a54bcd
- 06-conclusion.tex: 0d1abfe015aac929e93ef441f98d8c1a5de8dd71
- HenonEmden.lean: 6481354cae9713ce9f1e0db2ec5eb06a42c649ef
- README.md: 54bd8275076ded528ceb89e683ee53ddeff909b5
- LICENSE: 261eeb9e9f8b2b4b0d119366dda99c6fd7d35c64

The exact theorem declaration in [HenonEmden.lean](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/ComparatorChallenges/HenonEmden.lean) ends in an unfilled `sorry`. It is not a machine-checked proof of the source's nonexistence theorem.

The new manuscript is a modified and extended mathematical reconstruction of the source mechanism, not an unmodified upstream file. It replaces the Newton kernel by arbitrary Riesz order, proves the required low-order virial with simultaneous transport of both source densities, checks every changed tail exponent, and uses a standard local regularity theorem to cover the stated continuous solution class. Its core interval and source-layer arguments are attributed to the upstream manuscript and are reproduced as mathematical derivations rather than invoked as an unverified black-box theorem.

The new proof has undergone separate AI-assisted component and whole-argument checks. Those are not external independent specialist review or formal verification. Historical priority is assessed by a bounded primary-literature comparison, not established by the absence of a matchin
